purpose: Project-symbolic vertical navigation model anchored at the North / Axis Gate. Depth is conceptual, not geographic elevation.
boundary: Only level 0 is ordinary geographic Earth. Positive and negative levels are project-symbolic interpretive planes. They do not describe physical altitude, underground geography, territorial sovereignty, or empirical cosmology.

anchor.label: North / Axis Gate
anchor.geographic_reference: High Arctic / North Pole visual threshold north of Greenland
anchor.relation: Earth-side anchor for movement between project-symbolic planes

levels.label: Subterrain
levels.description: Lowest current project-symbolic depth: hidden systems, buried context and underground structure. Not literal subterranean geography.

levels.label: Swamp / Subculture
levels.description: Project diagnostic layer for subculture, harassment, opacity, extraction and broken relational systems. It is a metaphorical mechanism layer, not a label for peoples or nations.

levels.label: Roots of Ash
levels.description: The downward root system of the Axis Tree: chronology, causes, ancestry, memory, buried records and unresolved origins.

levels.label: Earth / North Gate
levels.description: Ordinary geographic Earth remains visible here. The North bubble is the threshold object linking geography to the project-symbolic vertical axis.

levels.label: Spiral Ladder
levels.description: The first upward project-symbolic transition: Jacob's-ladder / spiral-stair / Axis movement connecting Earth to higher relational integration.

levels.label: Garden / Tree of Worlds
levels.description: A higher project-symbolic plane where the Axis appears as Tree of Worlds: roots below, trunk through the threshold, branches and rooms above.

levels.label: North of North / Heaven
levels.description: Highest current navigation plane: North of North, Heaven and source-facing project canon. It is intentionally non-geographic and receives no invented Earth coordinate.

navigation_rule: Use the North Gate as the transition anchor. Upward travel follows spiral/ladder/tree imagery; downward travel follows roots/ash/swamp/subterrain imagery. Additional levels may be added only when a durable project concept warrants them.
design_rule: Do not create filler levels to satisfy numerology. The current seven-state ladder is a usability scaffold, not a sacred number claim.
